notes: Mobile Harness Code — independent fork of Mobile Harness. v1.5.0: automatic model/provider rotation for coding agents — on transient failures (429/5xx/timeout) the DSH DeepSeek and Claude Code agents reconnect, then rotate through the next compatible model and provider (DeepSeek → Anthropic → OpenRouter), all fail-closed (mutating tools are never auto-replayed; 401/403 never cascade). Adds a Continuation Pack that preserves task, plan, recent messages, touched files and last-tool status across a model change. Rotation is opt-in under Settings → Model rotation. This APK is SIGNED (V3-only, production key); install mobile-harness-online.apk.
